historical_commentary.text: Bar codes remain in extremely widespread, still-relevant use today (alongside newer identifiers like QR codes and RFID), so the general topic remains directly applicable, though the specific 4D-side bar code generation/rendering techniques from 2002 have likely been superseded by more modern barcode libraries or fonts available for current 4D applications.
related_updates: Bar codes remain in widespread use today alongside newer identifiers like QR codes and RFID; modern bar code generation in 4D would likely use more current libraries/fonts than were available in 2002
